calls.reason: Reported Q3 figures plus the S-1's Q2 figures give about 78% compute growth against 45% revenue growth, which roughly backs the numbers. But the main point is a hedged guess about why Anthropic left out Q3, and no evidence shows its motive.

The S-1 and Yahoo Finance show about $430bn in non-cancellable commitments, but there is no payment schedule for the next few years and no later annual cost results. This forecast can't be checked yet.
Apollo's analysis of Ramp data shows venture backing among top AI spenders only. No customer-level evidence measures how many Anthropic customers are loss-making and dependent on outside funding.

The S-1 puts policy-violating revenue at 5–7% for the nine months to September, and the FT reported Anthropic told investors distillation was 5–7% of revenue. With $16.29bn first-half and $16.8bn Q3 revenue, 7% is about $2.31bn.
Calendar 2027 hasn't started yet. Broadcom's announcement only says deliveries are expected to begin in 2027, and there are no payment records.

This is an open-ended forecast with no later financial statements to test it. Q3 reports of adjusted profit settle nothing, and no evidence shows Anthropic deliberately withheld Q3 figures to mislead.
